newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two die in Russian helicopter crash, one injured.
newsitem.headline: Two die in Russian helicopter crash, one injured.

text.p: Two people were killed and one was injured when a Russian military helicopter crashed some 60 km (40 miles) south of Moscow, a spokesman at air force headquarters said on Wednesday.

"It was a training flight. But weather conditions were bad, including heavy snow and wind," the spokesman said. He said the pilot and the engineer were killed in the crash and the co-pilot was taken to hospital with serious injuries.
The Mi-8 helicopter crashed on Tuesday, but rescue workers only found the crash site on Wednesday. The spokesman said an investigation into the cause of the crash had been launched.
There have been a series of accidents involving Russian-built aircraft this year, including one on Tuesday when a military plane crashed on take-off in northwestern Russia.
Seventeen people, including the commander of the Leningrad military district, were killed in that crash.
